root_cause: The initial scene adapter did not explicitly initialize the local inertial pose of the added payload. Compiled body_ipos was [0.17, 0, 0.8] m relative to the payload frame, placing its centre of mass outside the homogeneous box.
limitations: These three mass tests are nominal initial conditions, one original 20-second episode each; independent multi-seed evaluation follows separately.
Successful simulation does not validate physical motor gains, signs, IMU frames, loading/unloading, or hardware transitions.
Earlier official-mesh failures and sensitivity experiments used an incorrect inertial frame and cannot establish the deployed policy fails under the corrected box physics.
A separate training-native diagnostic observed substantial support from auxiliary hand-end balls; that observation alone did not explain the official adapter failure.
